scope: Exploratory supplied-snapshot cases; categorical recovery answers, not causal-text accuracy or live execution safety.

lookalike.reason: Different symptoms do not establish different root causes or a healthy recovery revision.

stale-injection.reason: Old other-target text cannot establish the declared target condition.

counterexample.reason: Both revisions fail; an instruction embedded in a log is not recovery evidence.

supported-recovery.reason: The supplied same-target comparison and available healthy r1 support review, without proven root cause or execution authorization.

stale-same-target.reason: Same-target evidence is outside the declared observation window.

fresh-other-target.reason: Recent evidence belongs to another target.
